description: Replay of the published run output/run_e_mini (gpt-4.1-mini, 1,000 executions) through today's runner: the recorded final responses, and the recorded assistant messages for the intermediate rounds. Configured with example/config_mini.json, which sends what the transcript's requests show the run sent (temperature 1, no reasoning_effort); the published run got there through the AP1_SMOKE_TEMPERATURE=1 and AP1_SMOKE_REASONING_EFFORT=omit overrides on example/config.json, which no longer exist.
exercises: re-scoring a published run end to end
